ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: engineering ياخدوا قرارات من غير ما يبلّغوا الـ finance.

en.why: This system costs money and affects UX. Everyone must understand.
en.how: Monthly review with stakeholders. Cost breakdown. SLO status. Upcoming changes.
en.tradeoffs: Meetings consume time. But prevent surprises.
en.examples: Dashboard: storage cost trend, latency trend, upcoming capacity needs.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Engineering makes decisions without informing finance.

text.ar: Build vs Buy: managed services للـ infrastructure، build الـ business logic
text.en: Build vs Buy: managed services for infrastructure, build business logic

ar.why: بناء كل حاجة in-house مكلف. Managed services بتوفر time-to-market.
ar.how: Buy: S3، SQS، CloudFront، Aurora. Build: upload API، resize workers، moderation logic.
ar.tradeoffs: Managed = vendor lock-in + cost. Build = control + maintenance burden.
ar.examples: S3 vs self-hosted MinIO: S3 أسهل بكتير. Resize workers: custom لأن الـ logic specific.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تبني كل حاجة in-house "لأن أرخص"، الـ engineering time أغلى.

en.why: Building everything in-house is expensive. Managed services save time-to-market.
en.how: Buy: S3, SQS, CloudFront, Aurora. Build: upload API, resize workers, moderation logic.
en.tradeoffs: Managed = vendor lock-in + cost. Build = control + maintenance burden.
en.examples: S3 vs self-hosted MinIO: S3 is much easier. Resize workers: custom because logic is specific.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Building everything in-house "because it is cheaper", engineering time is more expensive.

text.ar: Documentation والـ knowledge sharing: architecture decisions، onboarding
text.en: Documentation and knowledge sharing: architecture decisions, onboarding

ar.why: الناس بتيجي وتمشي. الـ knowledge لازم تكون documented.
ar.how: ADRs (Architecture Decision Records). System diagrams. Onboarding guide.
ar.tradeoffs: Documentation بتـ outdated. بس أحسن من لا شيء.
ar.examples: ADR: "لماذا اخترنا presigned URLs بدل proxy". Diagram: system architecture.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: "الكود هو الـ documentation"، ده مش كفاية للـ newcomers.

en.why: People come and go. Knowledge must be documented.
en.how: ADRs (Architecture Decision Records). System diagrams. Onboarding guide.
en.tradeoffs: Documentation gets outdated. But better than nothing.
en.examples: ADR: "Why we chose presigned URLs instead of proxy". Diagram: system architecture.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: "Code is the documentation", that is not enough for newcomers.

rangeHint.ar: معامل الذروة المعتاد حوالي ٢–٤× متوسط الحمل.
rangeHint.en: Typical peak factor is about 2–4× average load.

rangeHint.ar: سعة API server المعتادة تقريباً ١٠٠٠–٢٠٠٠ طلب/ث.
rangeHint.en: A typical API server handles about 1,000–2,000 req/s.

steps.ar: 1) Uploads/day = DAU × uploads. Write QPS = uploads/day ÷ 86400.
steps.en: 1) Uploads/day = DAU × uploads. Write QPS = uploads/day ÷ 86400.

steps.ar: 2) Read QPS = write × ratio. Peak = read × peak factor.
steps.en: 2) Read QPS = write × ratio. Peak = read × peak factor.

steps.ar: 3) Storage/day من الحجم، والتخزين طويل الأمد = يوم × أيام/سنة × سنين.
steps.en: 3) Storage/day from size; long-term = day × days/year × years.

steps.ar: 4) Bandwidth ≈ reads × size. Servers ≈ peak ÷ per-server capacity.
steps.en: 4) Bandwidth ≈ reads × size. Servers ≈ peak ÷ per-server capacity.

description.ar: Redis cluster مش شغال. الـ metadata lookups كلها بتروح على الـ DB. الـ latency طالعة والـ DB CPU على 95%. إيه هتعمل؟
description.en: Redis cluster is down. All metadata lookups hit the DB. Latency is up and DB CPU is at 95%. What do you do?

checklist.ar: فعّل circuit breaker / fail-open للـ cache
checklist.en: Enable circuit breaker / fail-open for cache

checklist.ar: زوّد DB read replicas أو throttle reads
checklist.en: Scale DB read replicas or throttle reads

checklist.ar: رجّع cache من snapshot أو cold start تدريجي
checklist.en: Restore cache from snapshot or gradual cold start

checklist.ar: راقب error rate وp99 أثناء الاستعادة
checklist.en: Watch error rate and p99 during recovery

description.ar: حملة تسويقية خلّت الـ uploads والـ reads يزيدوا 10 أضعاف في نص ساعة. الـ workers بتأخر والـ queue بتتكدس. إيه خطتك؟
description.en: A marketing campaign caused uploads and reads to jump 10× in 30 minutes. Workers are lagging and the queue is backing up. What is your plan?

checklist.ar: Rate limit / degrade غير الضروري (thumbnails كبيرة)
checklist.en: Rate limit / degrade non-essential work (large thumbnails)
Increase CDN and cache TTLs temporarily

description.ar: الـ primary region (us-east) offline. الـ uploads واقفة والـ CDN بيرجع errors من الـ origin. إيه الـ failover steps؟
description.en: Primary region (us-east) is offline. Uploads are stuck and CDN returns origin errors. What are your failover steps?

checklist.ar: DNS / traffic shift للـ secondary region
checklist.en: DNS / traffic shift to secondary region

checklist.ar: Promote read replica أو standby DB
checklist.en: Promote read replica or standby DB

checklist.ar: أكد RPO/RTO والـ data integrity بعد الـ failover
checklist.en: Confirm RPO/RTO and data integrity after failover

checklist.ar: Communicate status للـ users والـ status page
checklist.en: Communicate status to users and status page

question.ar: معالجة الـ thumbnails: sync ولا async؟

expectedNote.ar: الإنترفيور غالباً مستني async عشان الـ upload latency تفضل قليلة.
expectedNote.en: Interviewers usually expect async so upload latency stays low.

consA.ar: Latency عالية، timeouts، صعوبة الـ scale
consA.en: High latency, timeouts, hard to scale

prosB.ar: Upload سريع، scale مستقل للـ workers

consB.ar: اليوزر يستنى شوية قبل ما الـ thumbs تجهز
consB.en: User waits a bit before thumbs are ready

whenOtherWins.ar: Sync ممكن لو الصور صغيرة جداً والـ SLA يطلب جاهزية فورية.
whenOtherWins.en: Sync can win for tiny images when SLA requires immediate readiness.

expectedNote.ar: الاتنين مقبولين لو تبرر. SQL للـ relations، NoSQL للـ scale الأفقي.
expectedNote.en: Both are fine if justified. SQL for relations, NoSQL for horizontal scale.

prosB.ar: Scale أفقي سهل، high write throughput
prosB.en: Easy horizontal scale, high write throughput

whenOtherWins.ar: SQL يفوز لو فيه علاقات معقدة وصلاحيات؛ NoSQL يفوز مع مليارات الصفوف.
whenOtherWins.en: SQL wins with complex relations/ACL; NoSQL wins with billions of rows.

question.ar: قراءة الصور: CDN ولا مباشرة من Object Storage؟
question.en: Image reads: CDN or direct from Object Storage?

expectedNote.ar: الـ CDN أساسي لـ read-heavy image delivery.
expectedNote.en: CDN is essential for read-heavy image delivery.

prosA.ar: Latency أقل، bandwidth أرخص، حماية للـ origin
prosA.en: Lower latency, cheaper bandwidth, origin protection
